Description
Since her breakthrough success in 1959, Barbie™ has always reflected the evolving cultural developments of the times, and adult collectors that span generations are now an established and loyal consumer base. In 1977 Superstar Barbie™ captured the glamour of a decade with with her subtly highlighted, long blonde hair, a new face sculpt with a dazzling smile, fashionably posed arms, and signature magenta pink gown. Barbie™ arguably redefined perceptions of celebrity and reflected the range of greater opportunities for women in the world of entertainment, captured in a truly special collectible 1oz silver legal tender coin with displayable packaging! Limited mintage of 3,000 coins.
